description: Signed artefacts written under a node's 01_Inbox/nocturnal/<lease_id>/<job_id>/ directory: one partial result per executed subtask and one manifest per participant. They are evidence, never knowledge, and are never promoted automatically.
non_goals: This contract does not grant authority.
It does not define cluster-job dispatch or placement; those are in CLUSTER_JOB_REALIZATION_DESIGN.md and the cluster-job envelope.
It does not make an artefact a vault page; the existing inbox review path is the only route to knowledge.

fields.answered: sorted list of subtask ids that produced a verified result
fields.missing: sorted list of subtask ids that did not answer; no padding, never silently empty

result.output: The full output text travels beside the signed projection as `output`; `output_sha256` binds it. A verifier rejects a result whose output hash does not match.
result.signature: The participant's Ed25519 node identity key over canonical JSON of signed_fields. The Master resolves that key from the signed registry entry's node_pubkey_b64, never from an inline key.

items.result_sha256: hex sha256 of the signed partial result file

subtasks.rule: A subtask appears exactly once. `answered: false` is allowed only when the same id appears in coverage.missing.

manifest.coverage: Same shape and rule as the result coverage. The manifest's missing set is the union of the participant's unanswered subtasks and any dispatched subtask with no verified result.
manifest.signature: The participant's Ed25519 node identity key over canonical JSON of signed_fields.

directory.atomic_write: Write the result file, fsync it, then write the manifest. A manifest may only name result files that are present and whose hashes match.
directory.commit: Commit only this directory in the node's local artifact repository, with a message naming the lease. Never push, never rewrite history, never touch a protected path.

inbox_rule: Artefacts stay in 01_Inbox/nocturnal/ until the existing inbox review path accepts them. Nothing in this contract promotes, indexes, or serves an artefact as knowledge.
secret_rule: No keys, tokens, .env contents, or unredacted personal pages are eligible inputs or outputs. The existing vault allow-list and guard rules still apply.

skill_eval_subtasks.purpose: A cluster subtask may run the deterministic skill-evaluation harness on the participant host instead of a model prompt, so the nocturnal aggregate carries signed review verdicts as audit evidence.

cluster_subtask.homogeneous: a job must not mix modes; the nocturnal manifest carries one model label

skill_eval_subtasks.candidate_ref: exactly one context_refs entry of the form fixture:<name>; <name> is a file stem under scripts/skill-evals/fixtures/ and must not contain a path separator
skill_eval_subtasks.output: the signed result output is one sparknet-skill-eval/1 record; output_sha256 binds it and the Master validates it before including it in network_evals

master_aggregate.written_by: the Master scheduler's dispatch after every participant result verifies
master_aggregate.network_evals: records and counts (pass, warn, fail, invalid) derived from verified participant outputs
master_aggregate.rule: derived audit evidence; never a promotion and never knowledge
